in_marathi.name: Iravati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of rivers
in_marathi.long_meaning: Iravati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Iravati is the name of a goddess in Hindu mythology who is the personification of rivers. She is often depicted as a beautiful woman with multiple arms holding a conch shell, a lotus, and a pot of water. Iravati is also known as the 'mother of rivers' and is revered for her nurturing and protective qualities.
